fields.description: Issue dated February 19, 1927 (Vol. 4, No. 6), edited by Wen R. Phillips. Includes editorials and commentary on Florida Power & Light stock and public-utility profits; calls to extend the Jockey Club racing season; notes on Miami’s winter tourist season and pricing; criticism of railroad crossing safety (FEC vs. Seaboard) and a letter about American Railway Express delivery-zone charges. Reports on Municipal Judge Dave J. Heffernan sentencing a merchant for an anti-Miami sign and reprints a petition/letter from prisoners in the Dade County stockade protesting food conditions. Features a bridge column by Sidney S. Lenz, local humor items (including “Little Geraldine”), society notes, and extensive local advertising (casinos, clubs, retail, oil leases, and services).
